title: द्वादशोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 12 · Yudhishthira considers the royal consecration

summary.en: Yudhishthira longs to perform the Rajasuya but hesitates, knowing its dangers. His brothers, ministers and priests urge him on, but he resolves to consult Krishna, and sends for him.
summary.kn: ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನು ರಾಜಸೂಯ ಮಾಡಲು ಹಂಬಲಿಸಿದರೂ ಅದರ ಅಪಾಯಗಳನ್ನರಿತು ಹಿಂಜರಿಯುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಸಹೋದರರು, ಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳು, ಪುರೋಹಿತರು ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹಿಸಿದರೂ ಶ್ರೀಕೃಷ್ಣನ ಸಲಹೆ ಪಡೆಯಲು ನಿಶ್ಚಯಿಸಿ ಅವನನ್ನು ಕರೆಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर राजसूय करना चाहते हैं पर उसके संकटों को जानकर हिचकते हैं। भाई, मन्त्री और पुरोहित उन्हें प्रोत्साहित करते हैं, पर वे श्रीकृष्ण से परामर्श का निश्चय कर उन्हें बुलवाते हैं।
summary.te: యుధిష్ఠిరుడు రాజసూయం చేయాలని కోరుకున్నా దాని ప్రమాదాలు తెలిసి సంకోచిస్తాడు. సోదరులు, మంత్రులు, పురోహితులు ప్రోత్సహించినా శ్రీకృష్ణుని సలహా తీసుకోవాలని నిశ్చయించి ఆయనను పిలిపిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: யுதிஷ்டிரர் ராஜஸூயம் செய்ய விரும்பினாலும் அதன் ஆபத்துகளை அறிந்து தயங்குகிறார். சகோதரர்கள், அமைச்சர்கள், புரோகிதர்கள் ஊக்குவித்தாலும் ஸ்ரீகிருஷ்ணரிடம் ஆலோசிக்கத் தீர்மானித்து அவரை அழைக்கிறார்.
summary.ml: രാജസൂയം നടത്താൻ യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നു, പക്ഷേ അതിലെ അപകടങ്ങൾ അറിഞ്ഞ് അദ്ദേഹം മടിക്കുന്നു. സഹോദരന്മാരും മന്ത്രിമാരും പുരോഹിതന്മാരും അദ്ദേഹത്തെ പ്രോത്സാഹിപ്പിക്കുന്നു, എങ്കിലും കൃഷ്ണനോട് ആലോചിക്കാമെന്ന് തീരുമാനിച്ച് അദ്ദേഹത്തെ വരുത്തുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 2.12; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Apr 19 2006

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
ऋषेस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा निशश्वास युधिष्ठिरः ।
चिन्तयन्राजसूयाप्तिं न लेभे शर्म भारत ॥

meaning.en: Hearing the seer's words, Yudhishthira sighed; thinking of how to carry out the Rajasuya, he found no rest, O Bharata.

verses.text:
राजर्षीणां हि तं श्रुत्वा महिमानं महात्मनाम् ।
यज्वनां कर्मभिः पुण्यैर्लोकप्राप्तिं समीक्ष्य च ॥

meaning.en: He had heard of the greatness of the great royal seers who had offered sacrifices, and had seen the worlds they won by their holy works.

verses.text:
हरिश्चन्द्रं च राजर्षिं रोचमानं विशेषतः ।
यज्वानं यज्ञमाहर्तुं राजसूयमियेष सः ॥

meaning.en: He especially admired the royal seer Harishchandra, a sacrificer, and he wished to perform the Rajasuya sacrifice.

verses.text:
युधिष्ठिरस्ततः सर्वानर्चयित्वा सभासदः ।
प्रत्यर्चितश्च तैः सर्वैर्यज्ञायैव मनो दधे ॥

meaning.en: Then Yudhishthira honored all those in the assembly and, honored by them in return, set his mind on the sacrifice.

verses.text:
स राजसूयं राजेन्द्र कुरूणामृषभः क्रतुम् ।
आहर्तुं प्रवणं चक्रे मनः संचिन्त्य सोऽसकृत् ॥

meaning.en: The bull of the Kurus, O king of kings, after repeatedly reflecting, inclined his mind toward performing the Rajasuya.

verses.text:
भूयश्चाद्भुतवीर्यौजा धर्ममेवानुपालयन् ।
किं हितं सर्वलोकानां भवेदिति मनो दधे ॥

meaning.en: Again, possessed of wondrous strength and vigor and always following dharma, he turned his thought to what would benefit all the worlds.

verses.text:
अनुगृह्णन्प्रजाः सर्वाः सर्वधर्मविदां वरः ।
अविशेषेण सर्वेषां हितं चक्रे युधिष्ठिरः ॥

meaning.en: Best of those who know all dharma, Yudhishthira showed favor to all his subjects and did good to everyone without distinction.

verses.text:
एवं गते ततस्तस्मिन्पितरीवाश्वसञ्जनाः ।
न तस्य विद्यते द्वेष्टा ततोऽस्याजातशत्रुता ॥

meaning.en: Because of this, people trusted him as they would a father; he had no enemy, and so he was called Ajatashatru.

verses.text:
स मन्त्रिणः समानाय्य भ्रातॄंश्च वदतां वरः ।
राजसूयं प्रति तदा पुनः पुनरपृच्छत ॥

meaning.en: Best of speakers, he called together his ministers and his brothers and asked them again and again about the Rajasuya.

verses.text:
ते पृच्छ्यमानाः सहिता वचोऽर्थ्यं मन्त्रिणस्तदा ।
युधिष्ठिरं महाप्राज्ञं यियक्षुमिदमब्रुवन् ॥

meaning.en: Questioned, the ministers together gave the greatly wise Yudhishthira, who wished to sacrifice, this fitting answer.

verses.text:
येनाभिषिक्तो नृपतिर्वारुणं गुणमृच्छति ।
तेन राजापि सन्कृत्स्नं सम्राड्गुणमभीप्सति ॥

meaning.en: "The king who is consecrated by it attains the quality of Varuna; therefore a king who is already a king desires the full quality of an emperor.

verses.text:
तस्य सम्राड्गुणार्हस्य भवतः कुरुनन्दन ।
राजसूयस्य समयं मन्यन्ते सुहृदस्तव ॥

meaning.en: "O delight of the Kurus, your friends think this is the time for the Rajasuya for you, who deserve the imperial quality.

verses.text:
तस्य यज्ञस्य समयः स्वाधीनः क्षत्रसंपदा ।
साम्ना षडग्नयो यस्मिंश्चीयन्ते संशितव्रतैः ॥

meaning.en: "The time for that sacrifice depends on the wealth of the warrior class; in it, six fires are built with the Saman chants by those of strict vows.

verses.text:
दर्वीहोमानुपादाय सर्वान्यः प्राप्नुते क्रतून् ।
अभिषेकं च यज्ञान्ते सर्वजित्तेन चोच्यते ॥

meaning.en: "By it one gains all the sacrifices through the ladle offerings, and at its end is the consecration; so it is called the conqueror of all.

verses.text:
समर्थोऽसि महाबाहो सर्वे ते वशगा वयम् ।
अविचार्य महाराज राजसूये मनः कुरु ॥

meaning.en: "You are able, mighty-armed one; all of us are under your control. Great king, set your mind on the Rajasuya without hesitation."

verses.text:
इत्येवं सुहृदः सर्वे पृथक्च सह चाब्रुवन् ।
स धर्म्यं पाण्डवस्तेषां वचः श्रुत्वा विशां पते ।
धृष्टमिष्टं वरिष्ठं च जग्राह मनसारिहा ॥

meaning.en: So all his friends spoke, separately and together. The Pandava, slayer of foes, hearing their righteous words, took them in his mind as bold, desirable and excellent.

verses.text:
श्रुत्वा सुहृद्वचस्तच्च जानंश्चाप्यात्मनः क्षमम् ।
पुनः पुनर्मनो दध्रे राजसूयाय भारत ॥

meaning.en: Hearing his friends' words and knowing himself able, he fixed his mind again and again on the Rajasuya, O Bharata.

verses.text:
स भ्रातृभिः पुनर्धीमानृत्विग्भिश्च महात्मभिः ।
धौम्यद्वैपायनाद्यैश्च मन्त्रयामास मन्त्रिभिः ॥

meaning.en: The wise king then took counsel again with his brothers, the great priests, his ministers, and Dhaumya, Dvaipayana and others.

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
इयं या राजसूयस्य सम्राडर्हस्य सुक्रतोः ।
श्रद्दधानस्य वदतः स्पृहा मे सा कथं भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: How can I have this desire for the Rajasuya, the fine sacrifice fit for an emperor, as I speak with faith?

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
एवमुक्तास्तु ते तेन राज्ञा राजीवलोचन ।
इदमूचुर्वचः काले धर्मात्मानं युधिष्ठिरम् ।
अर्हस्त्वमसि धर्मज्ञ राजसूयं महाक्रतुम् ॥

meaning.en: Thus addressed by the king, lotus-eyed Janamejaya, they replied at the right moment to the righteous Yudhishthira: "Knower of dharma, you deserve the great sacrifice, the Rajasuya."

verses.text:
अथैवमुक्ते नृपतावृत्विग्भिरृषिभिस्तथा ।
मन्त्रिणो भ्रातरश्चास्य तद्वचः प्रत्यपूजयन् ॥

meaning.en: When the king had spoken so, the priests and seers, with his ministers and brothers, honored his words.

verses.text:
स तु राजा महाप्राज्ञः पुनरेवात्मनात्मवान् ।
भूयो विममृशे पार्थो लोकानां हितकाम्यया ॥

meaning.en: But the wise king, self-possessed, again reflected within himself, wishing the good of the worlds.

verses.text:
सामर्थ्ययोगं संप्रेक्ष्य देशकालौ व्ययागमौ ।
विमृश्य सम्यक्च धिया कुर्वन्प्राज्ञो न सीदति ॥

meaning.en: A wise man, having looked at his capacity, the place and time, and the income and expense, and having thought well, does not fail in what he does.

verses.text:
न हि यज्ञसमारम्भः केवलात्मविपत्तये ।
भवतीति समाज्ञाय यत्नतः कार्यमुद्वहन् ॥

meaning.en: Knowing that beginning a sacrifice is not merely a risk to oneself, he took up the task with care.

verses.text:
स निश्चयार्थं कार्यस्य कृष्णमेव जनार्दनम् ।
सर्वलोकात्परं मत्वा जगाम मनसा हरिम् ॥

meaning.en: To settle the matter he thought of Krishna Janardana alone as the highest in all the world, and went to Hari in thought.

verses.text:
अप्रमेयं महाबाहुं कामाज्जातमजं नृषु ।
पाण्डवस्तर्कयामास कर्मभिर्देवसंमितैः ॥

meaning.en: The Pandava reflected on the immeasurable, mighty-armed one, born among men by his own will, unborn in truth, by his deeds that matched those of the gods.

verses.text:
नास्य किंचिदविज्ञातं नास्य किंचिदकर्मजम् ।
न स किंचिन्न विषहेदिति कृष्णममन्यत ॥

meaning.en: He believed of Krishna that nothing was unknown to him, nothing was not done by him, and nothing was beyond his power.

verses.text:
स तु तां नैष्ठिकीं बुद्धिं कृत्वा पार्थो युधिष्ठिरः ।
गुरुवद्भूतगुरवे प्राहिणोद्दूतमञ्जसा ॥

meaning.en: Having made that firm decision, Partha Yudhishthira promptly sent a messenger to Krishna, the teacher of beings, as to an elder.

verses.text:
शीघ्रगेन रथेनाशु स दूतः प्राप्य यादवान् ।
द्वारकावासिनं कृष्णं द्वारवत्यां समासदत् ॥

meaning.en: On a swift chariot the messenger quickly reached the Yadavas and met Krishna in Dvaravati, where he lived.

verses.text:
दर्शनाकाङ्क्षिणं पार्थं दर्शनाकाङ्क्षयाच्युतः ।
इन्द्रसेनेन सहित इन्द्रप्रस्थं ययौ तदा ॥

meaning.en: Achyuta, wishing to see Partha as Partha wished to see him, then went to Indraprastha with Indrasena.

verses.text:
व्यतीत्य विविधान्देशांस्त्वरावान्क्षिप्रवाहनः ।
इन्द्रप्रस्थगतं पार्थमभ्यगच्छज्जनार्दनः ॥

meaning.en: Passing through many lands with swift horses and in haste, Janardana reached Partha at Indraprastha.

verses.text:
स गृहे भ्रातृवद्भ्रात्रा धर्मराजेन पूजितः ।
भीमेन च ततोऽपश्यत्स्वसारं प्रीतिमान्पितुः ॥

meaning.en: In the house he was honored by Dharmaraja, who treated him as a brother, and by Bhima; then, glad, he saw his father's sister.

verses.text:
प्रीतः प्रियेण सुहृदा रेमे स सहितस्तदा ।
अर्जुनेन यमाभ्यां च गुरुवत्पर्युपस्थितः ॥

meaning.en: Pleased with his dear friends, he rejoiced, waited on like an elder by Arjuna and the twins.

verses.text:
तं विश्रान्तं शुभे देशे क्षणिनं कल्यमच्युतम् ।
धर्मराजः समागम्य ज्ञापयत्स्वं प्रयोजनम् ॥

meaning.en: When he had rested in a good place, and at a favorable time, the king of dharma approached the unfailing Krishna and told him his purpose.

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
प्रार्थितो राजसूयो मे न चासौ केवलेप्सया ।
प्राप्यते येन तत्ते ह विदितं कृष्ण सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: I desire the Rajasuya, Krishna, but it is not gained by wishing alone; you know fully by what means it is obtained.

verses.text:
यस्मिन्सर्वं संभवति यश्च सर्वत्र पूज्यते ।
यश्च सर्वेश्वरो राजा राजसूयं स विन्दति ॥

meaning.en: The one in whom everything arises, who is honored everywhere and who is lord of all, that king obtains the Rajasuya.

verses.text:
तं राजसूयं सुहृदः कार्यमाहुः समेत्य मे ।
तत्र मे निश्चिततमं तव कृष्ण गिरा भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: My friends have come together and tell me I should do that Rajasuya; on this, let your word make the matter most certain, Krishna.

verses.text:
केचिद्धि सौहृदादेव दोषं न परिचक्षते ।
अर्थहेतोस्तथैवान्ये प्रियमेव वदन्त्युत ॥

meaning.en: Some, out of friendship, do not point out a fault; others, for gain, say only what pleases.

verses.text:
प्रियमेव परीप्सन्ते केचिदात्मनि यद्धितम् ।
एवंप्रायाश्च दृश्यन्ते जनवादाः प्रयोजने ॥

meaning.en: Some seek only what pleases, what they take to be good for themselves; talk of this sort is commonly seen when people have something at stake.

verses.text:
त्वं तु हेतूनतीत्यैतान्कामक्रोधौ व्यतीत्य च ।
परमं नः क्षमं लोके यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: But you rise above such motives and above desire and anger; you should tell us truly what is best in the world.
